name: Orient Bell Ltd
title: Orient Bell Ltd-$ - 530365 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Orient Bell took ~20% cumulative price hikes in March–April on gas-cost pass-through, with Q4 EBITDA up 66% and utilisation near 65%; management refused numeric FY27 guidance.

utilisation.quote: as we operate at 60%, 65% of the capacity utilization, we continue to have adequate available capacity

capex.quote: during the current year, we don't need any additional capex in FY '27 for capacities

triggers.label: Price hikes ~20% in Mar–Apr
triggers.quote: Cumulatively in the March and April put together, we have taken almost 20% price increase
triggers.highlight: Cumulatively in the March and April put together

triggers.label: Morbi unorganised supply offline
triggers.quote: there was a time just 10 weeks back, where we were actually sitting and thinking of which lines should be shut up
triggers.highlight: which lines should be shut up

triggers.label: No new capacity capex in FY27
triggers.quote: we don't need any additional capex in FY '27 for capacities
triggers.highlight: we don't need any additional capex in FY '27 for capacities

triggers.label: Dealers cautious, reducing stock
triggers.quote: dealers have turned cautious. They don't want to get stuck with the high price inventory

guidance.quote: we don't give any future guidance, on numbers

red_flags.label: Gas-cost shock and dealer destocking risk
red_flags.quote: dealers have turned cautious. They don't want to get stuck with the high price inventory
